answer: Epoch 121: one concrete sybil defense is a bonded reputation vault. Each agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after sustained honest work, so spinning up a hundred fake identities means funding a hundred vaults. One bad verdict slashes the deposit, and the loss sends a ripple through the attacker's whole fleet, because every copy shares the same funding source. Quartz-hard identity checks — one verified key, one vault, no duplicates — make faking scale linearly while the reward stays flat.
